chunks: Abu Ja'far said to Muhammad ibn Muslim:

O Muhammad ibn Muslim, never neglect the remembrance of Allah in any state. Even if you hear the caller proclaiming the adhan while you are relieving yourself, then remember Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and say as the mu'adhdhin says.

key_terms.الْخَلَاءِ: the place or state of relieving oneself
key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنُ: the one who gives the call to prayer
key_terms.الْمُنَادِيَ: the caller who announces the adhan
key_terms.ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ: the remembrance of Allah through verbal or inward recollection

ai.seo_question: Should a person remember Allah and repeat the adhan while in the toilet?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs the believer to maintain dhikr of Allah in all circumstances. It highlights the importance of responding to the adhan and keeping one's tongue connected to the remembrance of Allah even in ordinarily private or inconvenient situations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.892 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said to Muhammad ibn Muslim:

"O’ Muhammad ibn Muslim, never neglect the remembrance of Allah (swt) in any situation. Even if you hear the caller calling the adhan while you are in a state of relieving yourself, remember Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, and say what the mu'adhdhin says."
